claim: BEE rows by district (point in Census 2011 district polygon, mapped to the LGD code): 8,232 rows; 30 of 31 districts have at least one row; the largest are Bengaluru Urban 6,352; Bengaluru Rural 203; Dakshina Kannada 165.
caveat: Charger location is a point, so district assignment is valid for supply. Census 2011 polygons: rows in Vijayanagara are counted in Ballari (the 2011 polygon includes it). Stated and point districts disagree for 247 rows; the point is used.

claim: 67 of 67 RTOs have a verified district grouping: 61 map to one district; KA7, KA8, KA40, KA67 to Kolar + Chikkaballapura; KA34, KA35 to Ballari + Vijayanagar.
caveat: Each unit's offices sum exactly to the Transport Department's district totals (31-03-2021 stock and 2021-22 new registrations). Office names and addresses are not used as evidence. Combined units are not split.
